name: Akira
source: A young man grieving the recent loss of his girlfriend. After visiting the abandoned Kagetsu Mansion, he meets the women who once resided there and is offered a chance to resurrect his girlfriend through a special ritual.
translation: A young man grieving the recent loss of his girlfriend. After visiting the abandoned Kagetsu Mansion, he meets the women who once resided there and is offered a chance to resurrect his girlfriend through a special ritual.
